cands.name: Kerry Bubba Underwood

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 3 since November 2022. Certified public accountant who owned Underwood & Associates CPA and worked as a CPA for NortonUnderwood PC. Former mayor of Tuscumbia, Alabama. University of North Alabama graduate.
cands.gaps: Raised: the sources don't say where he grew up or when, if ever, he moved to Alabama. His 2022 survey mentions a high-school job at a church in Leighton, but doesn't name the state or say he grew up there. The Ballotpedia page has no list of bills he sponsored, so his legislative deeds couldn't be checked. We found no stated positions from him on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth limits, immigration or H-1B, police pay, guns, abortion or school choice. His 2022 survey mentions only general support for small government, recruiting industry, first responders and mental health policy. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him in 2026, and he did not complete its 2026 survey. We found no controversies, foreign ties or land-use positions. Dates of his time as Tuscumbia mayor aren't given.
